title: Credential noted in a work comment (universal) — review required
description: A work-item comment names a credential with a value: (?:TODO|FIXME|XXX|HACK)b[^#n]*(?:password|passwd|secret|toke. Comments ship to every checkout and are rarely scrubbed, so noted secrets persist indefinitely. This lexical rule flags the note; the reviewer confirms no live value or rotates it.
remediation: Remove the value from the comment; track the work in a secret manager plus a value-free ticket without secrets.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches credential-adjacent notes regardless of value liveness.
